items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Then I heard Tatum, he was something, he was tremendous.

ctx.x: Who were you listening to, what piano players were you listening to then?
Teddy Wilson and Jess Stacy; some of the guys that were around then, Fats Waller. Then I heard Tatum, he was something, he was tremendous.
Were you aware of Ellington's work at that time, more than casually aware of?
